paper.citation: Sant'Anna, P. H. C. and Zhao, J. (2020). Doubly robust difference-in-differences estimators. Journal of Econometrics 219(1), 101–122. DOI: 10.1016/j.jeconom.2020.06.003.
paper.source_version: Author-hosted manuscript dated May 5, 2020; 35 pages; retrieved 2026-10-23
paper.source_locator: PDF page 20, Section 4.1, definitions of f_reg/f_ps/Z and DGP1, following paragraph for noise, observed panel, and ATT=0; page 19 for original n=1000.

mechanism.name: Sant'Anna--Zhao DGP1: two-period panel with covariate-specific trends

generation_equations.label: Innovations
generation_equations.expression: eta,epsilon0,epsilon1(0),epsilon1(1) are independent N(0,1), independent of X,U

sampling.unit: individual with a two-period panel stored in one wide row
sampling.dependence: iid between individuals; baseline and post-period outcomes within an individual share latent v and covariates

assumptions: Consistency and no interference across independent panel individuals.
No anticipation: baseline observed outcome is Y_0(0).
Conditional parallel trends given observed Z: E[Y_1(0)-Y_0(0)|D,Z]=f_reg(Z) for either group.
Pointwise overlap for finite Z through logistic assignment. No uniform bound away from zero or one is asserted on unbounded support.
Independent normal innovations conditional on Z,D; latent time-invariant v is shared across both periods and counterfactual post-period states.

properties.notes: Four observed baseline Z variables enter both prognosis and propensity. Transformations of raw normal X include exp, ratio, cubic product and squared sum; logistic treatment is nonlinear. Shared v creates within-unit dependence. This is not high-dimensional confounding.

estimand.name: ATT = E[Y_1(1)-Y_1(0) | D=1]
estimand.definition: Population ATT for the treated group at post-period 1. The realized group D and latent v are held fixed across treatment counterfactuals. Original value is zero; this is not the observed post-period group contrast or a sample-average effect.

truth.expression: Population ATT for the treated group at post-period 1. The realized group D and latent v are held fixed across treatment counterfactuals. Original value is zero; this is not the observed post-period group contrast or a sample-average effect.
truth.derivation: Analytic cancellation of shared 2*f_reg(Z)+v in post-period potential outcomes; independent centered errors yield ATT=0. Numerical potential-mean and parallel-trend checks in verify.py.

adaptations: Retain the original DGP1 distribution and population ATT=0. Only DGP1 is registered; the paper also presents DGP2-DGP4.
Use Python/NumPy PCG64 instead of attempting identical draws from original estimator experiments; n=128 is an interface smoke check, not the original n=1000 experiment.
Represent each iid individual as one wide row (Z1-Z4,D,Y_pre,Y_post), preserving shared latent v across periods; raw X and potential outcomes are not released.
Compute source population normalization using analytic moments for Ztilde1,3,4 and a 120-node Gauss-Hermite constant for Var(Ztilde2). Do not standardize using the realized sample.
Expose att_shift=0 for the original scenario; nonzero shifts are verification controls only, not paper scenarios or extra families.
